about_the_game:
■ Overview

An immersive sim set in an absurdly dystopian and nihilistic world. Eliminate your targets in a fast-paced, ultra-violent fashion. Talk to lunatics, and explore surreal environments with psychedelic visuals and mind-bending soundscapes.

■ Play Time

Around 5 hours for the main content.

Around 8 hours including side content.

Around 10 levels. (I won't spoil you)

■ Recommended If You Like

Immersive sims.

Creative ways to get to your target.

Absurd worlds full of degenerates.

Over-the-top violence.

Deep lore.

■ Not Recommended If

You are photosensitive, the visuals are psychedelic, aggressively colorful.

You don't like being exposed to the shallow, selfish, and malevolent part of humanity.

You don't like having your mind blasted into a deranged dimension.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is ultra-violent and gory. There is a lot of blood and killing.
The world it’s set in is deeply deranged and nihilistic.
